# Rima Fathallah

> Rima Fathallah is an AI engineer in Tunisia. She builds machine learning systems, from research models to products people use, and is open to research and AI roles.

Rima Fathallah is a computer science graduate with over 3 years of practical experience in Python, machine learning, and work automation. She develops data-driven applications and integrates intelligent models into real-world systems.

## Facts

- Role: AI Engineer

- Status: Open to research and AI roles
- Languages: Arabic (native), English (DET C1), French (DELF B2), German (ELIT A1)
- Completed research: MITACS Global Research Internship at Concordia University, Montreal, January 2025 to July 2025
- In progress: a pediatric cerebral palsy study with Sahloul University Hospital, still in the brainstorming phase, with Hached University Hospital
- Current work: AI Developer Engineer at Exceed Your Limits Marketing, March 2026 to present, Germany, remote
- Selected projects: NEXOVA, Autonomous Data Analysis Agent, Patient Risk Assessment, Misinformation Detection, ToolMind, DEXTRA, Talynk
